title: Yellowed Crisp Turkish Lamb Kebabs
description: Charred and crispy lamb kebabs cooked to perfection on a cedar plank, featuring rapeseed oil and render fat for a rich flavor, sugar free friendly.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium high heat, around 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together rapeseed oil, render fat, garlic, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the marinade.
Thread the marinated lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on the soaked cedar planks, leaving a small space between each skewer.
Place the cedar planks on the grill and cook for 10-12 minutes, or until the lamb is charred and crispy.
Flip the skewers halfway through cooking to ensure even cooking.
Once cooked, remove the skewers from the grill and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
